query:
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, '-', district) as race, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status, primary_winner
FROM house_races 
WHERE candidate1_name = candidate2_name AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_code, district
LIMIT 20;
